subject.title: feat(gateway): add context engine control API

question: Should OpenClaw expose context-engine status, doctor, and rotate as a core Gateway/plugin control API after the session-targeting blocker is fixed?
rationale: This PR creates a new public Gateway endpoint and optional ContextEngine plugin contract, which is a product/API boundary decision beyond the mechanical session canonicalization bug.

options.title: Approve after scoping fix
options.body: Keep the core API direction, but require canonical session targeting, focused regression tests, and maintainer-reviewed docs/scope semantics before merge.

options.title: Narrow the control surface
options.body: Land only the read-only capabilities/status/doctor subset first and revisit admin rotate after owner approval.

options.title: Defer to plugins
options.body: Hold or close this core PR and keep context-engine maintenance control on plugin/private surfaces until a stronger core contract exists.

recommendation.title: Approve after scoping fix
recommendation.body: Keep the core API direction, but require canonical session targeting, focused regression tests, and maintainer-reviewed docs/scope semantics before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The unresolved blocker and public control-plane scope are centered on Gateway session ownership and operator controls, where recent current-main history points strongest to steipete.
